question: What is the antonym of "Tenebrous"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **1) Bright**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Tenebrous"** means dark, shadowy, or obscure. It is often used to describe something that lacks light or is associated with gloominess. (अंधकारमय/अंधेरा)
 
 
• **Example:** The old, tenebrous forest seemed eerie and unwelcoming.
 

 
• The word **"Bright"** refers to something that emits or reflects a lot of light or is full of energy and positivity. (चमकदार)
 
 
• **Example:** The bright sunlight filled the room with warmth and cheer.
